narrative.intro: M1 Support Services L P obligated $680M in FY2026 to date. M1 Support Services L P received 15 awards so far this fiscal year, with an average award size of $45.3M. Obligations fell 29.8% year over year in the current reporting period. Historical obligations show an upward trend through FY25 followed by the current decline: FY21 was $831M, FY22 was $821M, FY23 was $849M, FY24 was $904M, and FY25 was $969M. Other Support Activities for Air Transportation is M1 Support Services L P’s primary market in FY2026 to date, accounting for $653M of obligations. Aircraft Manufacturing is a secondary market, accounting for $27.4M. The current-year totals are partial and represent fiscal year to date activity. Readers should treat average award size and award count as current-year, partial measures rather than full-year totals. This snapshot highlights a concentrated market exposure in air transportation support and a sharp year-over-year drop in obligations for FY2026 to date.

sections.heading: How concentrated is M1 Support Services L P’s business in FY2026 to date?
sections.body: M1 Support Services L P’s business is highly concentrated in Other Support Activities for Air Transportation, which accounts for $653M of FY2026 to date obligations. Aircraft Manufacturing accounts for $27.4M, indicating a strong skew toward air-transport support work. The company received 15 awards so far this fiscal year, with an average award size of $45.3M, which reflects relatively large, few awards rather than many small contracts.

sections.heading: How has M1 Support Services L P’s federal revenue trended recently?
sections.body: Obligations peaked in FY25 at $969M before falling to $680M in FY26 to date, a change described as down 29.8% year over year. Yearly obligations prior to FY25 were $904M in FY24, $849M in FY23, $821M in FY22, and $831M in FY21. The FY2026 figure is a fiscal year to date total and not a full-year amount.
